_comment: variant: ltw1 = KGW-style context-hashed green list, ltw0 = unigram (fixed) green list -- the paper's more paraphrase-robust arm. k is the selector's context window and MUST be identical at generation and detection (the Detector class's own default is 10, which would replay a different gating decision than generation made). Sampling params are LTW's own loop, not the shared protocol, so its PPL is only comparable to its paired unwatermarked text. Set output_tag when sweeping gamma/delta so runs do not collide.
